arms.SAFE_DONOR_YOKED_REPLAY: open-loop replay of the fire / no-fire sequence AND the intended bites that SAFE_ONLINE_TRIGGER produced on a DIFFERENT block: block k of a size replays the schedule of block (k+1) mod 9 of the same size. Never the same clone, never the same seed.
arms.SAFE_FIXED_SCHEDULE: reused verbatim from 08B: attempt one quantum at every opportunity. No new engine call.
arms.SAFE_LAGGED_SENSOR: the identical online rule, but reading a sensor snapshot taken one opportunity (16 steps) earlier. Closed-loop in structure, stale in time.
arms.SAFE_ONLINE_TRIGGER: act at an opportunity iff feasible_q >= 0.9 * intended_bite AND mask_registration >= 0.10; otherwise wait and bank the quantum

budget_matching.backlog: an opportunity that is skipped adds its quantum to a backlog, capped at 4 quanta; the last opportunity flushes whatever backlog remains
budget_matching.consequence: the ATTEMPTED mass is exactly 320 quanta in every arm. Only its distribution in time differs.
budget_matching.note: matching on DELIVERED mass would be matching on a post-intervention variable and is used only as a clearly labelled secondary ratio
budget_matching.opportunities: 320, at spacing 16, identical in every arm

interpretation_rules_sealed.FEEDBACK_VALUE_ESTABLISHED: ONLINE beats FIXED and ONLINE beats DONOR_YOKED and ONLINE beats LAGGED, on the primary endpoint, by paired sign test p < 0.05
interpretation_rules_sealed.FUTILE_CYCLE: delivered mass rises without a rise in UNIQUE_CAUSAL_REPLACEMENT
interpretation_rules_sealed.SAFE_ABSTENTION: survival rises but delivered mass falls below half of FIXED's without a significant gain in UNIQUE_CAUSAL_REPLACEMENT

oracle_firewall.enforcement: everything the policy reads comes from p08_core.sensor_readout, which is AST-audited by fixture 5
the_policy_may_read: sink capacity under the active amount rule
source capacity under the active amount rule
its own backlog and its own past decisions

primary_endpoint: UNIQUE_CAUSAL_REPLACEMENT, as sealed in p08b_protocol.json, unchanged
prohibitions_carried_forward: internal decisions are never statistical replicates
the nine blocks stay in every ITT analysis including after track loss
delivered mass is a diagnostic, never a substitute for exchange
no life / identity / autonomy / metabolism / organisation claim is fabricated

trigger_parameters_frozen.chosen_a_priori: kappa = 0.9 means 'act when the state can absorb almost all of the intended bite'; the registration floor is the value below which P07 showed the frozen actuator has effectively lost contact with its target. Neither was tuned on 08B or 08C data.

what_varies: WHEN only. The AMOUNT rule is held fixed at the 08B factorial cell selected by the sealed 08B rule; WHERE is the frozen P07 geometry in every arm; the attempted mass is matched by construction.
why_a_waiting_controller_cannot_beat_rho: The 08A saturation probe measured, independently of any delivery curve, that free room reopens at a rate rho that is MAXIMAL at zero headroom and decays as headroom accumulates (late/early slope ratio 0.76, CI [0.752, 0.767], n=90). A controller that waits therefore operates where the substrate reopens room more slowly. It cannot raise the sustained flux. Its only possible value is on the FUTILITY and SURVIVAL axes: skipping events that would mostly recycle already-injected matter, or that would act while the actuator has lost its grip on the target.
